It also generates reports on important metrics like Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), energy metering, resource utilization, and much more.

While everyone else is stuck with boring individual chatbots, we've cracked the impossible: Alfi reads the room, understands each person, and creates custom intelligence for every group chat.

Alfi is your new social friend. The one who remembers everything, plans effortlessly, and keeps the crew together.

name: Standout
one_liner: Agentic hiring marketplace
description:
Standout gives every talent and company an autonomous agent that represents them, assess the other side, and makes intros when it matters.

Why it matters? Because this is hiring today:
- Talent use AI to apply to 100s of jobs - this is spam.
- Founders/Recruiting send 100s of AI-generated messages to hire the same talent - this is spam.

This has to stop.

Talent stays fully anonymous until they accept an intro. The best way for passively exploring the market and not missing a life changing opportunity.

In 1 month, 10k talent / 60 companies / 100 intros.

In one place, you incorporate, open accounts, take payments, launch a product, and run the operational work of the business: marketing campaigns, customer support, content production, and growth experiments, with agents inside Result helping the founder do the work.

Clinical and experimental data is fragmented, unstructured, and locked inside hospitals, labs, and CROs, while generating new data is slow and expensive. BioStack fixes this with proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that turn real biomedical workflows into ML-ready training environments.

The way we learn any task - by seeing, doing, and feeling - is how we train robots. We're building general intelligence that works on any robot and fits seamlessly within our world.

As businesses look to scale their AI prototypes into production-grade products, they struggle with large AI bills, slow APIs and large failure rates.
